nodes.description: Public address state variable storing the contract owner, initialized to msg.sender at deployment.
Public uint state variable tracking the last completed migration index.
Access-control modifier that requires msg.sender == owner before executing the modified function body.
Public function guarded by the restricted modifier that updates the migration counter.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership initialization and access-control checks.
Caller-supplied uint parameter that becomes the new value of last_completed_migration.
State-mutating assignment last_completed_migration = completed executed inside setCompleted.

edges.reason: owner is initialized directly from msg.sender, so the deploying caller becomes the privileged owner.
restricted modifier uses msg.sender in its authorization comparison against owner.
restricted modifier reads the owner state variable as the trusted reference address.
The restricted modifier gates execution of setCompleted, enforcing owner-only access.
setCompleted executes the state-mutating assignment to last_completed_migration.
The completed parameter flows directly into the state write.
The assignment writes the caller-supplied value into the last_completed_migration state variable.

normalization_plan.reason: The completed parameter is only used as the input value for the setCompleted function's state write and should be normalized into the enclosing function node.
